title: "Gouache in the Wild" reviewed on USK
content: "Citizen Sketcher,"Marc Holmesof the Urban Sketchers blog reviewed "Gouache in the Wild," and here's an excerpt:"The take away here is Gurney’s passion for the potential of this under-utilized medium. He is here to demonstrate how gouache can offer you all the advantages of opaque painting in oils or acrylics, but in a fast drying, clean and portable, water-soluble media that is highly suited to working on location, sketch-booking and the small studies which many painters enjoy on location."----Urban Sketchers Full ReviewDownload HD video at Gumroad
